in_hebrew.name: אַלְבֶה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The Hebrew name Lovell is derived from the Hebrew word אַלְבֶה (alev), which means 'calf' or 'young bull'. In the Bible, the name is not directly found, but it can be derived from the name Lebanon, which means 'white as a calf'. The long-term meaning of the name Lovell in Hebrew would be 'white as a calf' or 'young bull'.

in_greek.name: Λούβης
in_greek.long_meaning: The Greek name Lovell is derived from the Greek word Λούβης (Louvos), which means 'lion'. This name is not directly found in the Bible, but it can be found in the New Testament in the Book of Revelation, where a 'lamb with the horns of a lamb and the voice of a lion' is described (Revelation 5:6). The long-term meaning of the name Lovell in Greek would be 'lion'.

in_latin.name: Lovellus
in_latin.long_meaning: The Latin name Lovell is derived from the Latin word 'Lovellus', which means 'lover' or 'beloved'. This name is not directly found in the Bible, but it is derived from the Latin word 'amare', which means 'to love'. The long-term meaning of the name Lovell in Latin would be 'lover' or 'beloved'.
